svg.title: The Remittance Control Cell
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-remittance-posting-cell; chapter number: 11; title: The Remittance Control Cell; subtitle: Roles that make every 835 dollar balance to the deposit; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Payment Posting Lead; headcount: Not reported by the cited practitioners; focus: Charged minus adjustments equals paid, with the TRN trace number tying each ERA to its EFT deposit; spokes: role: EDI Intake Specialist; type: Raw 835 handling; kpi: No raw 835 opened in a Word-type editor; role: Contract Variance Auditor; type: Remittance versus fee schedule; kpi: 30 to 40 percent AR drop over about 60 days; 75 cents to $1 underpayment per claim surfaced; role: Denial Code Analyst; type: CARC and RARC triage; kpi: CO versus PR never confused; CARC 29 timely filing often 90 to 180 days; role: Cash Reconciler; type: Deposit matching; kpi: Deposit total matches remittance total with every PLB recoupment line worked; caption: The operator who reads group codes, CARCs, and RARCs controls cash, and no EFT is posted without its remittance.; assumptions note: Role split is an editorial grouping of reported tasks; the $200 billed, $80 CO45, $100 PR1, $20 paid example illustrates the balance check.; note: Attributed to Health Weave RCM LLC (bPFE9F4Y_Y4), The Claim Game X Practice Solutions (FE6Ns41GFH0), AarkNine Healthcare (3HP5mg0UdCw), and EDI PowerTools by EMS Healthcare Informatics (JfPjIRaIz-o).
